high_level_description: The image is a cover for "Best of Esquire 2023." It features a muscular man standing shirtless on a beach, with his body covered in mud. He has wet hair and appears to be in the middle of a rainstorm, as water droplets are visible in the air. The background shows a serene landscape with a body of water and a mountainous area covered in greenery. The overall mood of the image is rugged and natural, emphasizing the man's physical strength and the raw beauty of the outdoor setting. The text "Best of Esquire 2023" is prominently displayed at the top
